profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It reported revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, and trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. The company offers a broad platform spanning customer relationship management, business intelligence, and workplace collaboration, with AI capabilities embedded across its core products.

On the AI side, Salesforce tracks three main products. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging platform and provides features the company describes as channel and thread summaries, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, conversation translation, and workflow automation. The site states that customer data is not used to train the underlying large language models and that those models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Slack also serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, allowing agents built on that platform to operate within Slack channels, threads, and direct messages. Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce together constitute the company's broader CRM-embedded AI and autonomous agent offering, while Tableau AI, branded under the Einstein name, brings natural language querying and a Trust Layer governance framework to the company's business intelligence product.

The held facts show six Model Context Protocol servers registered in connection with Salesforce, covering functions such as comprehensive Salesforce administration, SOQL queries against Salesforce orgs, and Salesforce DevOps pipeline management. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
